*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

Across the multiverse are beings chosen not only to traverse the cosmos but to expand upon it, tapping into their innate magical abilities to weave new tapestries into the planar fabric. In time, these creative endeavors expand from simple demiplanes to entire planes formed in their creator’s image, establishing a permanent mark upon reality.

The planeshaper is a class template suitable for the oracle, psychic, and sorcerer classes. When converting a character to a planeshaper, the character loses or changes the following class features.

- **Oracle:** The oracle gains the bonus spells granted from planescuplting in place of their mystery spells. The oracle does not gain a revelation at 1st, 7th, and 15th levels. The oracle does not gain a final revelation.
- **Psychic:** The psychic gains the bonus spells granted from planescuplting in place of their discipline spells. The psychic does not gain a phrenic amplification at 1st, 7th, or 15th levels. The psychic does not gain remade self.
- **Sorcerer:** The sorcerer gains the bonus spells granted from planescuplting in place of their bloodline spells. The sorcerer does not gain a bloodline power at 1st, 15th, and 20th levels. The sorcerer does not gain a bloodline feat at 7th level.

**Planesculpting:** Whenever the planeshaper would gain a bonus spell as a result of their bloodline, mystery, or discipline, they instead gain one of the following spells of the listed spell level.

- 1st—alarm
- 2nd—rope trick
- 3rd—instigate psychic duel
- 4th—create mindscape
- 5th—mage’s private sanctum
- 6th—greater create mindscape
- 7th—lesser create demiplane
- 8th—create demiplane
- 9th—greater create demiplane

**Personal Plane (Su):** At 1st level, the planeshaper gains access to a unique extradimensional space in which they can store objects. This extradimensional space functions as a bag of holding (type I), save that it does not take the form of a physical bag but rather a portal which the planeshaper can open or close anywhere on their person. Retrieving something from or putting something into the personal plane is a move action.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the contents limit and contents volume limit of the personal plane double, to a maximum of 128,000 lbs and 15,360 cubic feet at 19th level. At 6th level, retrieving something from or putting something into the personal plane becomes a swift action. At 12th level, it becomes a free action.

**Planar Refuge (Su):** At 7th level, the planeshaper may designate one extradimensional space created through personal plane or through the rope trick, create mindscape, mage’s private sanctum, greater create mindscape, mage’s magnificent mansion, lesser create demiplane, create demiplane, or greater create demiplane spells as their planar refuge. (Other spells may be used at GM discretion). The planar Refuge’s duration becomes permanent, and the planeshaper gains a constant arcane eye spell that allows them to explore the inside of their planar refuge from anywhere in the multiverse.

**Planar Sovereign (Su):** At 15th level, the planeshaper gains greater control over their planar refuge. They gain the ability to use plane shift as a spell-like ability at will, although this ability may only be used to transport creatures or objects to and from the planeshaper’s planar refuge. In addition, the planeshaper may as a full-round action pull a creature or object from their planar refuge, causing it to appear with close range of them.

**Planer Domain (Su):** At 20th level, the planeshaper’s Planar Refuge evolves from a simple demiplane into a plane in its own right. When a demiplane is designated as the planeshaper’s Planar Refuge, it no longer possesses a maximum size, being as large as the planeshaper desires. In addition, as part of casting any create demiplane spell which affects their planar refuge, the planeshaper can use magic populate the demiplane with any creatures they so desire, although these creatures have a maximum CR of the planeshaper’s caster level -10 (these creatures cannot be summoned with planar sovereign). In addition, the planeshaper’s planar refuge cannot be dispelled or disjoined.
